description: This Java source file defines the custom exception class 'MissingThingIdsException' in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException, providing mechanisms for building, creating from JSON, and setting headers for this specific exception related to missing 'thing' IDs in a command.

classes.name: MissingThingIdsException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that multiple things were requested without specifying IDs. Extends DittoRuntimeException and is immutable, with a builder pattern for instantiation and a static method for creation from JSON.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of MissingThingIdsException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders.
